facts.fact: Liberia, Ghana and Sierra Leone signed their entry into the ECOWAS Free Roaming Agreement at a ceremony in Monrovia, to remove roaming charges among the three countries; the LTA page carries no date, so as_of is the published date 2026-02-20, taken by proxy.

systems.owner: ECOWAS; Liberia Telecommunications Authority for Liberia

note: The parties only reaffirmed commitment to full implementation, so no effect fact.
